description: Needs a connected MentionedOn account with a paid or 7-day trial monitoring slot (Local is $99/month). Use first when fixing business information: fetches a few public pages of the saved business website and saves candidate facts with where each was found. Pass revision from get_website_fixes (0 if none) and authorizationAcknowledged: true once the user confirms they own the site. Saves a new revision; refused once drafts exist; up to 20 website checks a day. Runs no AI scan and publishes nothing.

authorizationAcknowledged.description: true once the user confirms they own or may inspect this website.

revision.description: Integer from get_website_fixes (the current saved revision); use 0 when no record exists.

name: inspect_business_website
title: Inspect your business website
